post_text:
Day 10/30 — IExceptionHandler in ASP.NET Core 8 (.NET & C#)

Custom try-catch middleware pollutes request pipelines and forces repetitive context wrapping.

• **Pipeline Integration:** Native handlers cleanly intercept exceptions before they reach developer controllers.
• **Status Mapping:** Centralized logic maps specific exception types directly to correct HTTP status codes.
• **Memory Efficiency:** Reduces unnecessary delegate allocations during error states.

Watch out: Register handlers via AddExceptionHandler and UseExceptionHandler or unhandled faults still return default HTML.

Have you migrated your legacy error middleware yet?
